policy: Every shipped voice and announcer line is generated locally by an engine whose code, weights and voice allow redistribution of the output in a GPL game, commercial use included. No real person's voice is cloned: non-English speakers are cloned from English clips spoken by Kokoro voicepacks.

kokoro.license_evidence: https://huggingface.co/hexgrad/Kokoro-82M (model card: license apache-2.0; voicepacks ship in the same repository under the same license; the card lists its training data as permissive/non-copyrighted audio, including synthetic audio from closed TTS providers)

chatterbox.license_evidence: https://huggingface.co/ResembleAI/chatterbox (model card: license mit; languages include ar, tr, zh). Output carries Resemble's inaudible Perth watermark.

moss-fa.package: Hugging Face remote code at the pinned revision (Apache-2.0)
moss-fa.license_evidence: https://huggingface.co/nimaaaAI/MOSS-TTS-Nano-Persian/blob/main/LICENSE (Apache-2.0; fine-tuned only on Mozilla Common Voice Persian v13, CC0); base and codec model cards: license apache-2.0; https://github.com/OpenMOSS/MOSS-TTS-Nano LICENSE Apache-2.0

qa.metric: character error rate against the script after punctuation/diacritic normalization

voice_review.status: machine-assisted first pass only; native-speaker sign-off is still required (owner gate)
voice_review.method: every non-English line re-transcribed from the shipped file with the pinned Whisper large-v3 (forced language, automatic language ID, translation), compared with the generation-time transcript, the script and its English line, and judged for wording; a line was regenerated when both transcriptions heard a different content word

call_signs.rcn-redspear-select-zh.wav: 红矛 -> 赤矛 (avoids the 红毛 homophone)

voice_review.added: Israel (he-IL) and Hezbollah (ar-LB): 48 native lines with 48 English counterparts, 2026-10-06
voice_review.persian_alternatives: tested 2026-10-06, not clearly better; Persian set kept (see rejected)

rejected.reason: Unofficial client of a Microsoft service; no license grants redistribution of its output. Removed from the mod.

rejected.candidate: Piper fa_IR voices (amir, ganji, ganji_adabi, reza_ibrahim)
rejected.reason: Each is fine-tuned from the en_US lessac voice, whose Blizzard 2013 dataset license is research-only and forbids commercial use (https://www.cstr.ed.ac.uk/projects/blizzard/2013/lessac_blizzard2013/license.html).
Model card gives no dataset license ('See URL'); the URL states none.
Labelled MIT, but it is a quantization of the CC BY-NC 4.0 Thomcles model, so the label cannot be relied on.
OpenRAIL model on a Kaggle dataset with no stated license.
License-compatible (Apache-2.0) but graded D by the model card; Chatterbox Multilingual (MIT) speaks Mandarin instead.
Its G2P has no Hebrew or Arabic (language codes a, b, e, f, h, i, j, p, z).
Hebrew is not among its 20 languages; Israel scripts: CER 0.46, Hebrew ID 0.02.

Its Hebrew front end expects niqqud (added by the optional dicta_onnx diacritizer, not installed); unpointed: CER 0.21, 4/24 lines clean, Hebrew ID 0.51; hand-pointed: CER 0.05, 18/24 clean, Hebrew ID 0.69. Chatterbox reads pointed text.
Hezbollah scripts: CER 0.19, 4/24 clean, Arabic ID 0.46, against CER 0.03, 18/24 clean, Arabic ID 0.90 for Chatterbox.

rejected.candidate: Persian alternatives to the MOSS fine-tune cloned from the English clip (CER 0.09, Persian ID 0.65)
rejected.reason: MOSS-TTS-Nano base: CER 0.19, ID 0.05. Fine-tune cloned from a synthetic Persian reference: CER 0.13, ID 0.54. Other speakers: bm_george CER 0.14, ID 0.44; am_fenrir CER 0.03, ID 0.76 on seeds 1-2 but CER 0.16, ID 0.71 on seeds 3-4; am_fenrir blends over four seeds: mean take CER 0.16 against 0.18 and ID 0.69 against 0.62. Not clearly better, so the Persian set was kept; Chatterbox has no Persian.
